timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. 53-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.76, creatinine 0.71, hemoglobin 14.9, pao2 53, platelets 287, sodium 140, wbc 8.5; vitals dbp 72-77, heart_rate 82-86, map 91-94, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 27-31, sbp 125-131, spo2 87-94, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.72, hemoglobin 14.9, platelets 277, sodium 141, wbc 8.2; vitals dbp 72-75, heart_rate 82-88, map 91-93, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 21-26, sbp 125-130, spo2 93-94, temp 36.9-37.2
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 53-year-old male, length of stay 5 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
